QuestInfo.name: Troubling Reports
QuestInfo.1:
#p2300004# is concerned that Orchid revealed the secrets of Magatia to #p2154009#, and about what he might do in the future. Go to the #bAlchemy Lab#k in Magatia, and find her #b#t4033650##k.

The hidden room is located on the 2nd floor of the building right next to Zenumist Society, and requires a password. The password is #bpassword#k.
QuestInfo.2:
You got the secret research back to #p2300004#,
along with the news that #p2159391# has appeared in
Magatia. #p2300004# believes that #p2154009# is trying to recover
the Black Mage's research against orders.


What is Gelimer up to? And is Orchid attempting to undermine him? Maybe she's trying to save her brother...
QuestInfo.demandSummary:
#i4033650:# #t4033650:# #c4033650# / 1

Proceed with the following quests in Magatia's
#bAlchemy Lab#k:

#b[Nathania's Secrets]
[The Return of Beryl]
[Encounter]
[Born to Hate]#k

0.0: What did you find?\r\n#b(You tell her about the strange people of Magatia, the girl, and the truth serum.)#k
0.1: As I suspected... The girl that visited Magatia will have been #bOrchid#k, the leader of the Black Wings. I would assume she knew of the Black Mage's alchemical research, since she was one of his first disciples.
0.2: I suspect that #p2154009# took the alchemy research from Orchid and used it for his own means. The thought of someone like him using such dangerous magic sends shivers down my spine. We will need to act quickly.
0.3: There is a document about the Black Mage's research hidden in #bmy secret lab in Magatia#k. I need you to go and get it immediately.

yes.0: My lab is on the 2nd floor of the building next to the Zenumist Society in Magatia. #bYou will need a password#k to get in... It's #bpassword#k.
yes.1: I know it's an easy password, but I'm a busy woman and I don't have time for frivolous sentiment. I will write it on your hand so that you do not forget.

no.0: There is no time for you to have second thoughts.

1.0: Great, you got the documents.\r\n#L0##b(You tell her that #p2159391# was in the secret lab.)#l\n#k
1.1: Interesting... Perhaps #p2154009# #bis trying to find the Black Mage's research on his own#k. This little development could mean there is dissension amongst their ranks. Tell the others.

yes.0: I must return to my research.

quest.0: The documents should be in #bthe hidden room#k in Magatia. It's on the 2nd floor of the building on the right of the Zenumist Society.
